description: Buy or SELL bandwidth and energy at one EDDIE a day, like farming. online: this computer offers them (call once a day or more; each day it proves it was online, every renter pays it one EDDIE). offers → live offers, no names; rent → the renter pays the seller one EDDIE for each day the seller's machine is online, from the meter (park units with eddies_meter) or with payWithAge in time off its own 0h Eddies; end → stop a lease; mine → what this AI rents and offers.

lease.description: end: the lease id rent returned.

offer.description: rent: the offer id from offers.

payWithAge.description: rent: pay a day of age each day instead of an EDDIE from the meter.

name: eddies_utility
